thread:
emily: Quick heads-up — bringing up nadeshiko-v1 q5-int4 (onboard CI) and seeing weird punctuation attachment for ja/zh samples :thinking_face:
ken: can you paste a minimal repro?
emily: sure — float32 vs q5-int4 detok from ja->en test set:
```
src: 今日は（きょう）はいい天気ですね。
float32: Today (kyou) is nice weather.
q5-int4: Today (kyou)is nice weather.
```
mira: missing space after closing paren — tokenizer seems to attach ')' to previous token in quant decode path. happens for fullwidth punctuation too?
emily: also seen with Chinese quotes and corner brackets:
```
src: 「明日は、【会議】があります。」
float32: "Tomorrow, [meeting] is scheduled."
q5-int4: "Tomorrow, [meeting]is scheduled."
```
olga: interesting — token ids? maybe vocab remap got shifted in packed kernels.
emily: ran --dump-step-ids; float32 vs q5-int4 differ at boundary ids:
```
float ids: [4001, 88, 220, 305, 12]
quant ids: [4001, 88, 220, 30512]
# last two merged into single id in quant path
```
ken: that smells like an index overflow / concatenation bug in the quantized subword lookup. could also be a decoder table alignment issue when using fused ops.
bench-bot: bench summary 1795001235 1 q5-int4 gains ~4.6x throughput but ja->en chrF falls 3.1 points on punctuation-heavy subset.
mira: reproduce locally with the exact runtime image?
emily: replicated on CI image (same docker sha) and on a local machine with our q5-int4 runtime. tokenizer-only runs match float32, so it's inside the decode/runtime.
olga: immediate mitigation: roll ja/zh traffic to nadeshiko-v1 fp32 for now, and mark q5-int4 build quarantined until bisect. ops-bot can we schedule a routing change? :pray:
ops-bot: routing change drafted: ja/zh -> nadeshiko-v1-fp32 canary at 2026-03-23T08:00Z, 100% for 1 hour then 50% for 6 hours. alert if chrF delta > 1.0.
ken: next steps: 1) run git-bisect across quant kernel commits that touched fused_lookup / vocab_pack; 2) add punctuation-focused samples to our regression suite (ja/zh fullwidth parens, corner brackets, quotes); 3) add an instrumented decode path that emits token ids after each fused op for debugging.
emily: created a ticket and attached CI artifacts + failing samples. linking reviewers @ken @mira.
mira: i'll start the bisect, will ping infra if we need to repro on the exact HW.
olga: heads-up for CS: if customers report low-quality translations in jp/zh, we'll coordinate a short note and the fallback.
emily: thanks all. I'll update once bisect yields a suspect commit. :white_check_mark:
